summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser have improved how video playback is managed across various formats, particularly focusing on MP4 files. By constraining the display size of MP4 tracks to their maximum dimensions, the browser ensures better rendering quality, while generating a black image for muted video chunks helps maintain consistent visual output. Additionally, advancements in calculating the true average video frame rate and optimizing the handling of video samples contribute to a more seamless viewing experience. These changes collectively aim to enhance performance and efficiency in video playback, which is crucial for users enjoying streaming content or video calls. Notably, **these enhancements also support a better synchronization of audio and video, minimizing lag and improving overall user satisfaction**.
